name: DevMerx AntiCopy – Content Copy Protection
author: devmerx

sections.description:
DevMerx AntiCopy raises the effort required to take your text and
images. Pick the kind of site you run during setup and it switches on protections that
suit it, or choose each one yourself.

Everything below is included in this download. There is no licence key, no trial period,
and nothing switches itself off later.

Protections

  • Protect Text — block selection and copying
  • Protect Images — block right-click saving and dragging
  • Disable Right Click
  • Disable Keyboard Shortcuts — Ctrl/Cmd + C, X, A, U, S
  • Block Drag & Drop
  • Prevent Print & Screenshot — blank print previews and block Ctrl/Cmd + P
  • Dev Tools Blocking — block the shortcuts that open developer tools
  • Legal Notice — warn anyone inspecting your site

Honest about the limits

No website can stop an operating-system screenshot, and anyone willing to open developer
tools can read what their browser already downloaded. AntiCopy stops casual copying and
raises the cost of scraping. It does not claim otherwise.

Built to stay out of the way

  • Logged-in editors and administrators are exempt by default.
  • Form fields, comment boxes, and the block editor keep normal copy and paste.
  • Cart, checkout, and account pages are never protected.
  • It stores nothing about your visitors and makes no outbound network requests.

A paid version is sold separately

Everything listed above is in this download and fully working. Nothing here is
locked, limited, time-limited or waiting on a licence key, and nothing below is hidden
inside this plugin. AntiCopy Pro and AntiCopy Business are a different
plugin, sold and downloaded from our own site — not an unlock code for this one.

They are listed here so you know what exists, not because anything is missing from what
you just installed.

AntiCopy Pro adds ten more protections:

  • Watermark — a CSS overlay, or burned into the image file itself with GD or Imagick
  • Social Media Image Block — meta tags, X-Robots-Tag headers and robots.txt rules
  • Mobile Long-Press Protection — the long-press menu that saves images on phones
  • Custom Alert Messages — your own wording, in an accessible ARIA-live toast
  • Screen Capture Monitoring
  • Spy Extension Detection
  • Block Code Injection
  • Web Scraping Protection — an off-screen honeypot route that catches link crawlers
  • Cookie / GDPR Banner — with a consent hook and a privacy policy link
  • Age Verification — an age gate with a configurable minimum age

AntiCopy Business adds four server-side protections, which decide whether
to build the page at all rather than acting in the browser:

  • Region Access — allow or block by country
  • IP Access — allow or block lists, with CIDR support
  • VPN & Proxy Detection
  • Bot Protection — user-agent blocking, honeypots and rate limiting

➜ See pricing and download AntiCopy Pro
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it through Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate it. The setup screen opens automatically.
  3. Pick the kind of site you run, or skip and choose features yourself under AntiCopy → Features.
sections.faq:
Will this stop everyone from copying my content?

No, and be wary of any plugin that says it will. These protections stop casual copying,
right-click saving, drag-and-drop, and most automated scrapers. Someone determined enough
to open developer tools can still read the page.

Will it break my forms or my checkout?

No. Form fields, text areas, and contenteditable regions are exempt, and cart, checkout,
and account pages are never protected.

Can I still copy things on my own site?

Yes. Anyone who can edit posts is exempt by default. You can turn that off under
AntiCopy → Features → General.

What does it record about my visitors?

Nothing. This version stores no visitor data, creates no database tables beyond its own
settings row, and never contacts an external server. There is no telemetry and no
analytics of any kind.

Does it work with a caching plugin?

Yes. Every protection here is decided in the browser, so a cached page behaves exactly
like an uncached one. Nothing needs to be excluded from your cache.

Does it slow my site down?

The front-end bundle is a single small JavaScript file and one stylesheet, both served
from your own server. Nothing is loaded from a third party.

Where do I get the paid version?

From devmerx.com — it is a separate plugin you
download and install instead of this one. There is no licence field anywhere
in this plugin and no upgrade button, because there is nothing here to unlock.

What happens if I delete the plugin?

Everything it created is removed: its settings, the post meta it added, and its scheduled
jobs. Deactivating the plugin leaves your settings alone — only deleting it clears them.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First release: eight content protections, a feature dashboard, and a setup wizard with
    presets for blogs, shops, membership sites, and portfolios.
  • Full translation catalogue; every browser-facing string comes from PHP.
  • Accessibility pass on the admin controls.
  • Verified against WordPress 7.1 on PHP 8.5.
